attchmntText: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited uploaded the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026 to its website. The company reported consolidated quarterly revenue of INR2,257 crores, a 17% year-on-year increase. Standalone revenue reached an all-time high of INR1,722 crores, up 19% year-on-year. Standalone EBITDA was INR191 crores with an 11% margin, down from 14% in the prior year quarter due to input cost inflation. Net profit from continuing operations was INR115 crores, a 14% decline year-on-year. The company maintains a net cash position of INR309 crores. Arka Fincap reported assets under management of INR7,781 crores and net NPAs of 0.5%.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 06, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited approved the execution of a Shareholders Agreement with TPG SG Arca Pte Ltd for TPG's proposed investment in step-down subsidiary Arka Fincap Limited. The agreement records rights and obligations among Kirloskar Oil Engines, wholly owned subsidiary Arka Financial Holdings Private Limited, Arka Fincap, and TPG. TPG will subscribe to equity and compulsorily convertible preference shares in two tranches. The first tranche involves an investment of INR 525,00,00,003 for 100 equity shares and 32,53,45,231 preference shares. The second tranche involves an investment of INR 275,00,00,588 for 12,93,34,496 preference shares, subject to business milestones and regulatory approvals. Post-investment, Kirloskar Oil Engines will hold 62.607% of Arka Fincap. The agreement grants TPG one nominee director and certain minority protection rights. There is no impact on the management or control of Kirloskar Oil Engines.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update'.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited approved the execution of a Shareholders Agreement with Arka Fincap Limited, Arka Financial Holdings Private Limited, and TPG SG Arca Pte Ltd on 6th November 2026. This agreement records rights and obligations regarding TPG's proposed investment in Arka Fincap. TPG will subscribe to equity and compulsorily convertible preference shares in two tranches. The first tranche involves an investment of INR 525,00,00,003. The second tranche involves an investment of INR 275,00,00,588, subject to business milestones and regulatory approvals. Following the first tranche, Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited will hold 68.587% of Arka Fincap. After the second tranche, the holding will reduce to 62.607%. The agreement includes provisions for investor nomination of one director and minority protection rights. There is no impact on the management or control of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited.
